description: On-chain Observations: cited public-ledger transactions, token transfers, contract deployments, first-inbound funding and quoted label assertions (src.kb.onchain), bounded receipted acquisition for one explicit identifier per request (src.ingestion.onchain), and probable address clustering with declared heuristics, a null model and a measured false-positive rate (src.kb.onchain_clustering). Read-only; no attribution verdicts.

semantic_constraints.identifiers: one explicit address, transaction hash or contract per request; CAIP-2 chain ids; names refused
semantic_constraints.revisions: unchanged re-acquisition adds nothing; changed content is a new revision; late older data is history; reorganisations, finality crossings and dropped transactions are explicit changes
semantic_constraints.labels: quoted from their source with licence and attribution; never restated as a finding
semantic_constraints.unknowns: an address no acquisition covered is unknown, never an empty success
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no person attribution, no wallet or key access, no transaction submission, no exchange or KYC data

semantic_constraints.status: probable; never an identity or ownership verdict
semantic_constraints.heuristics: common-input, deposit-address-reuse and deployer-funding are separate declared edge types, each edge citing its transactions
semantic_constraints.calibration: served threshold is the smallest level within the target FPR on a labelled synthetic fixture; the measured FPR is reported
semantic_constraints.bounds: traversal depth <= 3 and edge budget <= 200; refuses without a cited transaction
